messages:
liz_sales: MerchantCorp asked for a firm commit quote + burst behaviour. They want: reserved GPU pricing, burst credit mechanics, and whether we can peer (AWS Direct Connect) to reduce egress latency. Deadline: EOD Wed.
rohan_se: Can we get a quick profile? what steady RPS and peak spikes look like? also need their max seq len and avg tokens per request.
liz_sales: They gave an initial profile: baseline 120 rps, 95% requests ~40 tokens, peaks up to 900 rps for ~3–5min, and a nightly batch that spikes ~600 rps.
ben_infra: rough ops take: for steady 120 rps with our m60-like instance we map ~0.8 RPS per GPU for that model/seq (conservative). For baseline we'd reserve 150 GPUs to hit headroom. Peaks -> recommend reserved 150 + burst credits up to 300 for short spikes.
anya_security: KMS flow: for Private we can integrate customer KMS via our proxy; need an admin ACL + cert rotation window. If they require HSM-backed keys we need add-on for compliance.
rohan_se: autoscale policy suggestion: prewarm 10% of burst capacity using scheduled preheat during expected spike windows, and enable fast scale-out with queue_depth policy + fallback to cheaper quantized variant. Canary rollback if tail p90 latency > 800ms.
liz_sales: can you sketch a quick back-of-envelope cost delta for reserved 150 vs reserved 300? I'll pass to finance.
ben_infra: back-of-envelope: reserved150 = baseline $X/month (estimate) ; bursting to 300 via credits would add ~+40% op-ex if used 10% of month. If they want hard commit for 300 we'd price differently (discount + SLA). I'll send concrete numbers tomorrow.
rohan_se: operational notes: KV-cache warmup is critical after cold start — recommend a KV warmup script during preheat. Also suggest prefix caching for common prompts to cut token compute ~20%.
liz_sales: perfect. can we confirm peering ops? they said they want Direct Connect into our VPC for <10ms hop.
ben_infra: DC doable in Dedicated/private deployments. We'll need network team to confirm cross-AZ routing; also note extra egress billing.
anya_security: I'll send the security questionnaire answers for KMS + peering constraints. pls add me to the NDA + dataflow diagram review.
liz_sales: thanks all. action items: @ben_infra send cost sketch by tomorrow, @rohan_se write autoscale+warmup runbook snippet, @anya_security finalize security answers and KMS add-on wording. I'll consolidate for MerchantCorp. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: smoke-test: poc-env preheat job started (job-id: preheat-1759801122)
liz_sales: noted, will update the customer after we have the numbers.
__notes: Followup thread on commit sizing, burst credits, autoscale policy and peering for enterprise POC.
